review_evidence: Basic.lean: Defines CompletelyMonotoneOn, IsCompletelyMonotone, IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi with closure properties and prototypes (exp_neg_mul)
Bernstein/Basic.lean: Defines IsBernsteinFunction with derivative characterization and basic examples (const, id, affine, 1-exp)
Bernstein/Theorem.lean: Proves Bernstein's theorem (exists_representsLaplace_of_isCompletelyMonotone) via Chafaï measures and Prokhorov extraction
Bernstein/LevyKhintchine/Representation.lean: Proves existence of Levy-Khinchine representation for Bernstein functions
Bernstein/HausdorffBernsteinWidder.lean: States and proves the finite-measure HBW theorem with bernsteinMeasure API
FiniteDifference/Basic.lean: Introduces IsDifferenceCompletelyMonotone and proves equivalence with derivative form on C^∞ functions
FiniteDifference/Laplace.lean: Derives finite-difference form of HBW theorem via smoothing and compactness
Laplace/Representation.lean: Builds Laplace transform infrastructure (RepresentsLaplace, RepresentsLaplaceOnIoi) with uniqueness and easy direction
Stieltjes/Basic.lean: Defines RepresentsStieltjes and IsStieltjesFunction with cone structure and basic examples
Stieltjes/Uniqueness.lean: Proves uniqueness of Stieltjes and complete Bernstein representations via Laplace determinacy
summary: All 64 files in this work unit contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs related to completely monotone functions, Bernstein functions, Stieltjes functions, Laplace representations, Levy-Khinchine theory, and associated analysis. Every file has a module header, public imports, extensive mathematical documentation, and executable Lean declarations (def, theorem, lemma). None are pure import aggregators (FILTER-007) or empty of formal mathematics. All files advance the roadmap targets for completely monotone function theory and its connections to Bernstein/Stieltjes functions and Laplace transforms.
